_instructions: When renewing: tell Claude 'here is my new npm token: npm_xxx'. It will read this file, update every entry in usedIn[], update expiresAt, commit, and push. To add a new location, append an entry to usedIn[].
_expiryNote: INFERRED, not read from npm. npm exposes no token metadata without the token itself and GitHub secrets are write-only, so the true expiry cannot be looked up. The NPM_TOKEN secret was replaced 2026-09-09 and this workflow's own renewal instructions say to create it with a 90-day expiry, which gives 2026-12-08. Correct this if a different expiry was chosen. The weekly reminder no longer depends on this date being right: it probes the token with `npm whoami`, so a live token closes the reminder and a dead one opens it regardless of what this field says.
